documentation kind 12 FAIL -> 2 FAIL (184 pass / 118 warn / 1 skip). Nine doc edits re-authored after the peer-collision loss, each committed individually: 81575db VISION, 3eb85fb roadmap, c9e1634 API, 4ba61b5 ARCHITECTURE, 9573c4c AGENT-WORKFLOW-GUIDE, 4d1521a AUDIT-REPORT, d910d60 COMPONENTS, 77d1a99 migration-strategy, b1ae276 GRAPH-HELPERS-MIGRATION, 1781da6 quickstart frontmatter.

The 2 remaining documentation FAILs are both coderef/working/repo-review-2026-07-remediation/context.md (missing sections + no frontmatter). NOT FIXED, deliberately. Standing operator amendment: "Do NOT edit anything under coderef/archived/ or coderef/working/ -- those are historical records and must keep their original names." Editing the file to pass would violate the amendment; the FAIL is accepted as the honest state.
decisions_log.surfaced_question: The documentation kind already excludes **/coderef/workorder/** as working artifacts, and **/ARCHIVED/** as frozen history. coderef/working/** is neither excluded nor editable, so it can only ever FAIL. Options: (A) add **/coderef/working/** to the kind exclusion globs on the same frozen-history rationale as ARCHIVED, (B) leave it graded and carry a permanent 2-FAIL floor in every core project with a working folder, (C) scope it to the specific doctype. This is a fleet-wide standards-kind change, not a CORE-local fix -- NOT decided unilaterally.

decisions_log.detail: generate-quickstart template fixed at source (ASSISTANT ea0aa0c10) to emit title/status/updated + derived/generated_by/documents, per the generated-view-is-derived doctrine. The generated file was NOT regenerated: discover.cjs currently mis-derives project_name as "-coderef-core" (leading dash) and project_description as "title: @coderef/core" (leaks the frontmatter key), so a regeneration would DEGRADE the existing correct output. The output was instead synced to the fixed template by hand. discover.cjs defect is unfixed and belongs to the generate-quickstart skill owner.
